description: We're a team of five university students ready to turn crazy ideas into reality! 🚀 We love science, technology, innovation, and solving real-world problems. We're looking for creative, ambitious teammates with skills in programming, AI, data analysis, engineering, design, or scientific research. Most importantly, we want curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who aren't afraid to experiment. Got skills, wild ideas, and a passion for innovation? Let's build something out of this world!
